text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—And into the home stretch!!
The home stretch of the Japanese Derby!!
Up the hill they charge! Which Umamusume will seize victory!?!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —WOOOOAAHHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: (This is the end! I shall reduce you to cinders!!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I've locked onto you—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (THUD!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Ngh!? Are those a giant's footsteps—!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaahhh!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
(————Ah, I feel it, Kris S...!
In this very instant, you are about
to sever the chains of fate...!!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
(As expected, you are... we are beings bound by
the chains of fate, sharing its burden together...!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: (However—even that, right now...!!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: I will resist it!! OOOOOHHH!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She's done it! Symboli Kris S is victorious!!
Kicking away the fierce rivals of her generation, a majestic triumph!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Today, I gave it my all.
Yet... I lost.
It seems you have truly defied your fate.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ......Gimlet――

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Those eyes, that running style... both cold enough to freeze over the wild frenzy of the crowd...
I've burned them deep into my memory.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Gimlet!! So close!
Great job completing the Mile Championship rotation!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You were amaziiing!!
I'll never forget that runnn!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh... Hahahaha...—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Bwaaaaa-hahahaha!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Witnesses!
Go wild and rave with passion!!
Let Tanino Gimlet be seared into your eyes!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
(Gimlet!! Lady Gimlet!!
That was so close!! You're the strongest!!)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Senpai... You must be more frustrated than anyone else, and yet...
You stand so tall and proud...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Incredible...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Seriously, you're so cool... Gim-senpai...!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...That was—the fervor brought about by you—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...That's my line, Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Your running, as you trampled the chains of fate to pieces...
was truly beautiful—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Though she narrowly missed out on victory,
she fully proved her 'strength.'
As I went to greet Tanino Gimlet—"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —It didn't quite turn out to be the supreme cup, did it?
choice_data_list: Still, you drove me, the crowd, everyone wild!
Still, you drove me, the crowd, everyone wild!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I raised an invisible glass to Tanino Gimlet,
one brimming with undeniable warmth.
choice_data_list: Cheers to your speed and your strength.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ――Gim-senpai!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Vodka——

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—Um!!
Thank you so much... for your hard work in the Derby!!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I was so moved...!
And that's why, I...!!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Tch...... Dammit! The words won't......!
But, Senpai!! I really――――

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Did I look cool?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Did I look cooler in your eyes... than anyone or anything else?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Gim-senpai is... the coolest in the world...
She'll always, always be the senpai I look up to!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —I see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After parting ways with Vodka, who shared her heartfelt
thanks, I returned to the waiting room to find—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Something about Tanino Gimlet's posture strikes me
as terribly off. At first glance, she looks just as she always does, but—
choice_data_list: ...Is anything feeling off with your body?
...Does anything feel off with your body?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh—no problem at all. I may be exhausted from that mortal duel, but my soul is burning even brighter and hotter than it did back at the NHK Mile Cup...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even watching her speak with such certainty, I couldn't shake my sense of unease. Perhaps she herself hadn't realized that something was wrong—
choice_data_list: Let's get a detailed checkup right after this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to check immediately whether this sense of unease was real.
If it was nothing, we could just laugh it off.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...You sensed something, didn't you?
Then let us follow your intuition――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And after a detailed examination...
it was discovered that an abnormality was developing in Tanino Gimlet's left leg.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"—It was fortunate we caught it early this time.
Had we been even a little later, returning to racing
would have become entirely out of the question."

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Even so, the current situation doesn't allow for optimism.
You need to refrain from racing and rest until around the end of June.
choice_data_list: Will Gimlet be able to race again...?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
A possibility still remains.
...However, it will be an extremely harsh challenge.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: "If we are to work toward returning to racing, you must be prepared for the risk that the symptoms might worsen beyond what they are now."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...The day after the 'Japanese Derby'.
A whirlwind of frustration and helplessness raged inside me."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of Tanino Gimlet and everyone
cheering for her, we will see the Mile Championship
rotation through to a safe conclusion.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I swore that to myself and did everything I could.
And yet, I couldn't prevent
Tanino Gimlet from getting injured...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If only I hadn't been so powerless...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—However, I can't just stand still.
What I need to do right now is get Tanino Gimlet back on the track!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I desperately shake off the frustration and sense of powerlessness.
I need to reorganize the plan for Tanino Gimlet's comeback...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Working hard, I see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Around that time, she suddenly appeared.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing not a trace of gloom in her expression, I feel relieved.
I decide to consult with her right away about our plans moving forward—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...If it's to discuss future plans, there is no need.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...It truly was beautiful.
The sight after finishing the Japan Derby...
The sheer frenzy that took over that place.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
As if gazing down upon the end from a resplendent hall...
It was catastrophic, and yet, eternal.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"And I...—I was able to etch my own running into them
and find a new chaos that strives
toward an even more brilliant future."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
“—All of this belongs to you,
who fought alongside me.”

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Be proud.
And—what comes "next" is your turn.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —I've had enough.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
With this, my play comes to an end.
I shall step down from the stage of glittering stars...
and take my seat in the shadows.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Tanino Gimlet is now about to step away from racing. She is on the verge of locking away that potential by her own hand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I didn't want that. Absolutely not.
So I tried to stop it... I tried to speak the words
to bring it to a halt."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However————

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed. I shall remain unwavering,
betting everything on the MC rotation and my own aesthetic."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"If I dwell on what comes 'after',
these legs will hesitate, and I will lose my 'speed.'"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"'...The MC rotation is not something that can be achieved
with such half-baked "strength".'"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Therefore, I will forge ahead.
Without hesitation, with an iron will stronger than anyone's."

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"If you decide to work toward returning to racing,
you must be prepared for the risk
that the condition may worsen."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: “――――I've had enough.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The days I had spent with Tanino Gimlet.
The risks lurking in the future I was about to choose.
Her deeply satisfied expression. Everything blurred into chaos.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The words that were on the tip of my tongue vanished.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so...
just how much time had passed, one wonders—
choice_data_list: ........................You really saw it through, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tanino Gimlet made her dream come true. If she can say that with certainty... then what lies ahead is entirely her own domain.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As Tanino Gimlet's Trainer, nothing could make me prouder――――――than this.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...For now, I can only offer my gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Honestly, anything after that
is just a blur now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tanino Gimlet's announcement to retire from racing spread through the world in an instant—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To many, it brought shock, confusion, and—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It left a deep, indelible scar...—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: "—Tanino Gimlet's sudden declaration seems to have left the fans utterly bewildered, and opinions are flying in every direction."

text_block_list.name: Gimlet Fan A
text_block_list.text:
“—Well, since it's an injury...
I'd say it was a wise decision.”

text_block_list.name: Gimlet Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Because I'm sure it's with Gimlet's future in mind.
Besides, Gimlet has already achieved
more than enough wonderful results."

text_block_list.name: Gimlet Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"I'm devastated...
I wanted to see her race so much more..."

text_block_list.name: Gimlet Fan B
text_block_list.text: "『I can't help thinking it happened because she took on the MC Rotation... but taking on challenges like that is what makes Gimlet who she is... so it's complicated.』"

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
“—Everyone's saying all sorts of things, but
I really think the Trainer bears significant responsibility
for not stopping her after the Satsuki Sho.”

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"Gimlet basically had to run an entire extra race
worth of effort going into the Derby.
The fatigue must be on a completely different level."

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: ""How responsibility will be handled in this regard is something we'll want to keep an eye on going forward—""

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Day after day, the media covered Tanino Gimlet's
declaration, and voices began questioning
my responsibility for her injury.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fault of failing to prevent Tanino Gimlet's injury
lies squarely on me.
...I must take appropriate action.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yet, even before that……—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...The look Tanino Gimlet showed me back then.
The words Tanino Gimlet gave me."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "That brought about a sense of calm... inside my heart."
choice_data_list: If Gimlet isn't going to race anymore—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The sky outside the window was a refreshing, crisp blue.
